headline: Heavy Clashes Rake Central Sectors as Weathered Expanse Boils
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, ferocious fighting has escalated in Weathered Expanse, where six base exchanges were logged in the past two hours amidst more than twenty-five hundred casualties focused on Spirit Watch and Wightwalk. In Dead Lands, combat around Callahan's Boot generated three fresh ownership shifts alongside heavy casualties exceeding sixteen hundred in the two-hour span. Stonecradle remains intensely contested with two recent base transfers and mounting losses at The Long Fast and The Cord. Strategic base turnover has paused along the Stlican Shelf over the last two hours following earlier turmoil, while Godcrofts holds one unoccupied territory after prior clashes. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy continues to absorb massive attrition, recording over a thousand casualties in the latest two-hour window with losses accelerating on both sides despite static lines. In Callahan's Passage, a fresh surge in casualties and enlistments marks renewed pressure, even as frontline control remains unchanged.
